data.summary:
CSPO and PMP-certified Lead Business Analyst and Product Owner with 9+ years delivering payments and regulatory platforms across global banks.
Strong ownership of product backlogs, regulatory-driven prioritization, and Agile delivery across ISO 20022, GPP, and cloud data platforms.
Recognized for driving audit- ready releases, reducing delivery risk, and leading cross-functional teams through complex transformations.

responsibilities: Acted as Product Owner proxy, owning and prioritizing the backlog for payments and regulatory data migration.
Took day-to-day prioritization decisions, balancing regulatory deadlines, technical feasibility, and delivery risk.
Led backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews as the primary business representative.
Reviewed, validated, and formally accepted stories based on business rules, data accuracy, and compliance criteria.
Provided release sign-off and supported production deployments.
Contributed to quarterly roadmap planning aligned to regulatory milestones and cloud migration phases.
Delivered multiple regulatory and payments datasets with zero critical audit observations.
Reduced rework and reporting defects by approximately 25-30% through improved backlog clarity and acceptance criteria.
Defined and prioritized user stories for ISO 20022 MT to MX datasets, settlement statuses, and reporting logic; partnered with engineering and architecture teams to validate solution design.
Owned the regulatory reporting backlog, prioritizing enhancements and fixes based on regulatory impact and audit findings.
Acted as single point of contact for regulators, auditors, business stakeholders, and delivery teams.
Delivered 15+ regulatory reports across multiple releases with zero critical audit issues; accepted deliverables after validating data lineage, accuracy, and compliance readiness.
Improved reporting accuracy and audit readiness through structured gap analysis; drove prioritization of remediation items based on regulatory trends.
Supported Product Owner activities by gathering requirements, defining user stories, and supporting backlog prioritization.
Applied GPP domain expertise to validate payment flows, settlement logic, and ISO 20022 compliance.
Designed and validated BI data models supporting legacy-to-modern platform migration; improved delivery timelines through UAT and requirement clarification.

experience.company: Accenture, Deutsche Bank, Wells Fargo, Firstsource
responsibilities: Built foundation in payments, investigations, regulatory compliance, and Agile delivery across SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, cross-border payments, settlement, and exception handling.
Supported UAT cycles, defect triage, SQL-based data validation, and production releases across global bank programs.

Strategy, Roadmap and Impact
